decision_conditions:
1.	The development hereby approved shall not be implemented other than in accordance with the principles and methodology as described within the approved Arboricultural details ‘Arboricultural Method Statement ref: 2508 from SJ Stephens Associates, dated 06/03/2026’, unless otherwise previously agreed in writing with the local planning authority.

2.	Prior to commencement of works, confirmation of the appointment of a retained Arboricultural consultant to conduct and submit an auditable system of site supervision and monitoring shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. 

3.	Illustrated monitoring reports concerning the condition of retained trees shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, upon commencement and completion of works hereby approved. 

REASON:  To ensure that the tree(s) are not damaged or otherwise adversely affected by demolition, building operations, excavations and soil compaction.
description: Erection of a lower ground floor rear extension with an external terrace above, reinstatement of a two storey infill extension to the front, other alterations to the property including repairs to chimneys, reinstatement of the original roof form and alterations to the rear garden.
